title: [smime-tree] Handle SystemTime before UNIX_EPOCH in cert validation
description: Skoll MEDIUM-25: cert.rs validate_chain uses now.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default().as_secs() which silently converts pre-epoch times to zero. Return an error instead of silently using epoch zero for certificate validity checks.
close_reason: Changed unwrap_or_default() to return an error when SystemTime is before UNIX_EPOCH, instead of silently using epoch zero.
